events.verdict: Green (GSW) firms up in a screening position in Castle's (SAS) path and although he turns after the initial contact, any ensuing contact with Castle is marginal.
Barnes (SAS) clamps Butler III's (GSW) left arm as he spins, initiating contact that affects his SQBR on the drive.

Barnes (SAS) backs into Moody (GSW), who is in a legally obtained rebounding position. Moody places his hands on Barnes' back with slight extension, but the marginal contact does not cause Barnes to become dislodged from his position.
Moody (GSW) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession should have been awarded to San Antonio.
Green (GSW) takes an additional step late into Castle (SAS), delivering contact during the screen.

Green (GSW) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Johnson's (SAS) driving shot attempt. Although Green briefly brings his arm around Johnson's side, the contact is marginal.
Castle (SAS) dislodges Butler III (GSW) from his rebounding position.
Green (GSW) contests the driving shot attempt by Johnson (SAS) and the contact after the release is incidental. As Green continues to lower his arm, there is marginal contact to Johnson's head/face.
Green (GSW) closes out during the layup attempt by Johnson (SAS) and initiates illegal contact to his lower body, affecting his ability to return to the floor.
Green (GSW) establishes screening position in Castle's (SAS) path and marginal arm to arm contact occurs as Caste moves around the pick.
Barnes (SAS) initiates illegal contact with Green's (GSW) right arm.
Butler III (GSW) moves forward into Barnes (SAS), initiating illegal contact that moves him off his spot. The illegal contact precedes any traveling violation caused by the contact.
Butler III (GSW) legally contests Barnes' (SAS) jump shot attempt.
